blocks.play: Skip the morning and midday. Departures are steady but there's no early spike.
Work downtown, SLU and First Hill, timing a SEA run for the 4 PM arrival wave. Once a trip ends in Seattle, stay there.
Eat in the city and be rolling again by 7:30.
Optional: catch the 7 PM SEA arrival peak and ride back into the city. Be downtown by 9:15.
Work the let-outs from Neumos (about 10) to the Paramount, The Showbox and the Neptune (about 10:30 to 10:45), finishing at Showbox SoDo. Stage a block off the doors, not at the curb.

plan.headline: A dry, quiet Wednesday with a 10:15 to 11 PM let-out cluster: Cameron Whitcomb at the Paramount, She Wants Revenge at The Showbox, Ashley Cooke at Showbox SoDo and three smaller rooms. Anchor on 3 to 6:30 PM in the city and SEA, then work the let-outs; skip the morning.
